instruction: in/crontab.txt is a crontab. Skip blank lines, lines starting with #, and environment lines whose first space-separated token contains '='. Every other line is '<minute> <hour> * * * <command>' (command may contain spaces). Minute and hour fields are '*', '*/N' (every N starting at 0), or a comma list of integers. Write out/cron_plan.csv with header command,runs_per_day,first,last and one row per job in file order: how many times it runs in one day, and its earliest and latest run times as HH:MM (zero-padded).
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
